description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
Biotransference triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and create a 2/2 Necron Warrior token.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, allowing you to exile Leonin Relic-Warder due to Ygra.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its last ability triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
